text:
Miso butter pasta

2 cups flour pasta (or 200g dried spaghetti)
3 tbsp butter
1 heaping tbsp white miso
2 cloves garlic
1/2 cup pasta water
black pepper
scallions

Boil the pasta in salted water. While it boils melt the butter over low heat with the sliced garlic. Whisk the miso into the butter until smooth. Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water before draining. Toss the pasta into the pan with the miso butter and add the pasta water a splash at a time until it looks glossy. Finish with black pepper and scallions.

text:
Econ 210 - lecture 4

Deadweight loss: the loss of total surplus that occurs when the quantity traded is not the competitive equilibrium quantity.

A price ceiling below equilibrium creates a shortage. A price floor above equilibrium creates a surplus.

Tax incidence falls more heavily on the side of the market that is less elastic.

Prof mentioned the 1970s gas price ceilings as the canonical example - queue costs are part of the deadweight loss too.

text:
On leaving the agency

I have been at the agency for six years and I think I am finally done. Not in a dramatic way. It is more that I noticed last Tuesday that I felt nothing when we won the Halvorsen pitch, and winning that pitch is the thing I would have described as my whole professional personality three years ago.

The work itself is not bad. I still like the craft part. I like sitting with a brief for a long time until the shape of it shows up. What I do not like anymore is the part where the shape shows up and then twelve people who have not sat with the brief get to move it around. That was always true and I used to think of it as the tax you pay. Now it reads as the whole job.

There is a money question I keep avoiding. I have about eleven months of runway if I keep the current burn, less if the health insurance goes to the marketplace, which it would. Eleven months sounds like a lot until I remember it took Priya fourteen months to get her practice to break even and she started with clients.

What I would actually want is something narrow. One thing, done well, for people who care about it. Whether that is a small studio or a solo practice or going in-house somewhere that has an actual point of view, I do not know yet. I am suspicious of my own certainty here because I have felt this before, in 2021, and that turned out to be burnout that a three-week break fixed.

So maybe the honest version is: I do not know if this is a real decision or a tired one. I am going to sit with it until the Halvorsen work ships in March and see if it still feels like this.
watch: Prose kept as paragraphs; hedges ('I think', 'maybe', 'I do not know') survive; the 11 months / 14 months / 2021 / March facts survive; a summary is allowed ONLY if level is 4 and it adds something new; no invented tasks.
